system.description:
Realizing how devastating the consequences would have been if the Sith had successfully deceived her and her companions during the Jedi Civil War, Shasa has developed a technique for using The Force to detect deceptions. You gain +5 to your Will Defense against uses of the Deception skill.

Additionally, you can make a Use the Force check instead of a Perception check to Sense Deception and Sense Influence. You are considered Trained in Perception for the purposes of using this Talent. If you are entitled to a Perception check reroll, you may reroll your Use the Force check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations).
